title: fix(ui): long-text fields read label-on-top on the record page, headings one step smaller
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAoNwrZVJoUEFfvMURpRPKJ)_

Fixes #37801

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：记录页字段区里，多行文本、Markdown、富文本、多文件这类长字段改为标签在上、正文占满整列（实测正文从 212px 宽到 336px）；字段里的 Markdown/富文本标题缩小一档（一级标题 30px 变 18px）。
- 为什么做：记录页阅读样式三张卡里的第一张（不改元数据、不需新增设计记录的那一半），替制度类长正文在左栏被挤成窄条的问题解决。
- 出错会怎样：只影响记录页字段区长字段的排版与正文标题字号，不改数据和元数据；有问题可直接撤回本 PR。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **Field list, wide fields label-on-top** (`DetailSection.tsx`, frameless row only). A field for which the auto layout's own `isWideDetailField` is true (`textarea`, `markdown`, `html`, `richtext`, `grid`, or `file` / `image` with `multiple: true` on the object field) draws its label above the value: the row becomes `flex-col` (stretched), the label drops its `w-28 shrink-0` column. No second type list. The predicate is asked of the enriched field (view entry merged with the object field), so a section entry that carries no `type` still resolves through the object field — the same type the cell renderer draws with. Every other field keeps the label-left row. `data-detail-field`, `data-detail-field-row`, `data-detail-field-label` and the click-to-edit target (the value box, its `title`, the in-place editor anchor) are unchanged. The boxed face and the mobile grouped-inset face are untouched.
- **Document face headings one step smaller** (`richTextDisplay.tsx`). `RICH_TEXT_DOCUMENT_CLASS` = the shared typography + `prose-h1:text-lg prose-h2:text-base prose-h3:text-sm`. Elements stay `h1`–`h6` (the `?section=` anchor reads them). `RICH_TEXT_CELL_FACE_CLASS` is now built from the shared base, not from the document class, so it is byte-identical to before (pinned). Markdown and html/richtext read the one constant. The comment cites objectstack#36344.
- One patch changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` + `@object-ui/fields`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.wideFieldLabelTop-37801.test.tsx` — on the field list: `textarea`, `markdown`, `html`, `richtext` and multi-file rows are label-on-top (column, label first, no fixed width, value `min-w-0 flex-1`), rows keep `data-detail-field` / `data-detail-field-row`; `text`, `select` and single `file` keep the label-left row; a section entry without `type` resolves through the object field; a click on a wide value still calls `onEnterInlineEdit` and the value keeps its `Click to edit` title; the boxed face is unchanged.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/richTextDocumentHeadings-37801.test.tsx` — document face: markdown h1–h4 are still h1–h4 under the three size modifiers; html and richtext carry the same class string as markdown; the cell-face class is byte-for-byte the old string; in a grid column neither pipeline draws a heading element or a size modifier.
- Ablation (committed fix, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob == HEAD and empty `git diff HEAD`): forcing `labelOnTop` false reds 6 of 9 in the plugin-detail file (the five wide rows and the no-type case); removing the three modifiers reds 2 of 6 in the fields file (markdown sizes, class composition).

- New pins + `markdownCellHeading-36344`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 24 passed (24).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/ packages/fields/` plus `app-shell` `recordSectionAnchor.test.tsx` and `RecordDetailView.citedSection-37365.test.tsx`: Test Files 760 passed, 2 skipped (762); Tests 9146 passed, 25 skipped (9171); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/fields` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose include is every `src/**/*.test.tsx`): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 38 families for this diff; all 38 ran locally, every one exit 0 (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 172 files passed, 2 skipped; 5138 tests passed). `--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `ui` `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citation(s).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The value box now spans the full column (412 px including the 6 px hover bleed each side the editable value already had; the boxed face uses the same bleed to sit flush with a label above). The text block inside it measured 336 px, not 400: the field-history and copy buttons beside the value reserve 64 px (two 24 px buttons and their gaps) even while hidden at rest. That reservation is existing behaviour of the value box on every face and is not in this card's surface; moving those buttons onto the label line would give a wide field the remaining 64 px. Noted, not filed (polish).
- `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` still says, in the `inGridColumn` prop's comment, that the record page "keeps the heading sizes": it keeps the document face's sizes, which are now one step smaller. Outside this card's file surface; left as is.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 (docs-driven) asks for the package README and a `content/docs/frontend/` page on a feature change; this card's surface names neither, so no docs edit is in this PR.
- The smaller headings reach every document-face caller of the rich-content pipelines, a readonly form field included, by design of the card (one face, one constant).

## Verification

Browser check, showcase app (`examples/app-showcase`, own backend on a private port with `--fresh`, Console dev server from `ui/` source pointed at it), record `Specimen — Full` of `showcase_field_zoo` with a long markdown policy body, viewport 1204×1007, laid-out record page (field list in the left column, `data-detail-section-list` present). Screenshots were taken locally; the relay carries no image upload, so the measured values are given here.

| Reading | Before (origin/main 7ad103a6) | After (2258e166) |
|---|---|---|
| Markdown row direction | row | column |
| Label box | 112 × 32 px, left | 400 × 28 px, above |
| Value box width | 288 px | 412 px |
| Text block width (markdown and textarea) | 212 px | 336 px |
| Markdown row height | 1281 px | 818 px |
| h1 / h2 / h3 / body font size | 30 / 20 / 18 / 14 px | 18 / 16 / 14 / 14 px |
| Select row (control) | row, label 112 px | row, label 112 px |
| Page `scrollWidth` | 1204 | 1204 |

A click on the textarea value opened the in-place editor anchored on the value box: anchor and popover both x 48, width 336 px.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.wideFieldLabelTop-37801.test.tsx packages/fields/src/__tests__/richTextDocumentHeadings-37801.test.tsx` — expect 15 tests passed. In the app, open any record with a markdown field on the record page: the label sits above the body, which spans the column, and an `# H1` in it reads at 18 px.

Read first (by risk): `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` (the `labelOnTop` branch on the row and label classes), `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/richTextDisplay.tsx` (the cell face now built from the shared base, not from the document class).
